summary: Verified Vercel BUILD-time bug fix for `metadataBase: new URL(SITE_URL)` in src/app/layout.jsx. Ran `yarn build` (next build) with NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL present AND with the entire .env removed — both builds compile cleanly, generate all 16 static pages including /_not-found, and exit 0. No 'Failed to collect configuration for /_not-found' / 'Invalid URL' error. Full regression pass on all listed pages, sitemap/robots/llms.txt, SEO tags, homepage FAQ/LinkedIn (reactions 68/92/84)/Contact sections, and enquiry form submission (shows expected fallback since RESEND_API_KEY is placeholder).
action_items: USER (not code) action: Configure NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL=https://kailashgroup.com.au in Vercel Project Settings → Environment Variables (Production/Preview/Development) so canonical/OG URLs remain absolute on Vercel. Current code fix means the build no longer crashes without it, but SEO tags degrade to relative if it's missing.
critical_code_review_comments: Fix in src/app/layout.jsx (line 7) is correct and minimal — conditional spread `...(SITE_URL ? { metadataBase: new URL(SITE_URL) } : {})` guards the URL constructor.

src/lib/seo.js buildMetadata() still constructs `${SITE_URL}${path}` unconditionally — when SITE_URL is undefined this yields 'undefined/about' in canonical/OG URLs. Not a build-blocker, but should also guard. Low priority since Vercel env fix resolves it in production.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Build-time fix validated by twice running `cd /app/frontend && yarn build`: (1) with .env intact -> exit 0, (2) with .env moved aside (SITE_URL undefined) -> exit 0, both produce all 16 routes incl. /_not-found. .env was restored and frontend restarted. All 11 tested URLs return 200. sitemap/robots/llms.txt correctly reference https://kailashgroup.com.au. Enquiry form fallback error message renders as expected (Resend key is placeholder).
rca of the issue: Root cause: `new URL(undefined)` in Next.js 15 metadata is evaluated during `next build`'s static page-data collection phase for every route (including /_not-found), so any missing NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL crashed the entire build. Fix: conditionally include metadataBase only when SITE_URL is truthy. Reproduction: remove .env, run `yarn build`. Verification: after fix, build succeeds without the env var. Mitigation: also set NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL in Vercel dashboard so canonical tags stay absolute.
